title.purpose: Section headings above a well; h2/h3.

label.purpose: Data-table column headers, sentence case, tabular figures.

nav-group.purpose: Sidebar navigation group names only; uppercase.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Every overlay: dropdowns, modals, popovers, tooltips, toasts, command palette, and all re-pointed Tailwind shadow-* utilities.

shadows.name: input-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focused input, paired with an orange border.

shadows.name: lamp-housing
shadows.purpose: Status lamp rim (dark: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.12)); unlit lamps use inset 1.5px neutral-400 / coolgray-500.

shadows.name: focus-outline
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on buttons, tabs, menu items, links, [role=button]; red on error buttons.

motion.name: lamp-pulse
motion.purpose: In-progress status lamp; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Buttons and tabs; transform is neutralised so keys do not lift or press.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The charcoal key: the one primary action on a screen (Deploy, Save).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--appliance-primary,oklch(23% 0.006 70));background:var(--appliance-primary,oklch(23% 0.006 70));color:var(--appliance-primary-fg,oklch(99.3% 0.002 85));cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--appliance-primary-hover,oklch(31% 0.006 70));border-color:var(--appliance-primary-hover,oklch(31% 0.006 70))}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--appliance-focus,oklch(57% 0.18 44));outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default flat key on the off-white surface.
components.css: .ds-btn{font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;height:32px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--appliance-rule-strong,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.17));background:var(--appliance-surface,oklch(99.3% 0.002 85));color:var(--appliance-fg,oklch(19% 0.005 70));cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms}.ds-btn:hover{background:var(--color-neutral-100,oklch(93.8% 0.005 80))}.ds-btn:active{background:var(--color-neutral-200,oklch(89.6% 0.006 78))}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--appliance-focus,oklch(57% 0.18 44));outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Off-white field with a strong hairline; orange border and ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input{font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;font-size:14px;height:32px;padding:6px 12px;width:280px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--appliance-rule-strong,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.17));background:var(--appliance-surface,oklch(99.3% 0.002 85));color:var(--appliance-fg,oklch(19% 0.005 70));caret-color:var(--color-accent,oklch(57% 0.18 44))}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--appliance-focus,oklch(57% 0.18 44));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--appliance-focus,oklch(57% 0.18 44))}

components.name: Settings Section
components.description: A heading on the canvas over one hairline well; never a box in a box.
components.css: .ds-section{font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;background:var(--appliance-canvas,oklch(96.4% 0.004 80));padding:16px;color:var(--appliance-fg,oklch(19% 0.005 70))}.ds-section-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.005em;margin:0;padding:0 0 10px}.ds-well{background:var(--appliance-surface,oklch(99.3% 0.002 85));border:1px solid var(--appliance-rule,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.1));border-radius:8px}.ds-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:14px;padding:12px 16px}.ds-row+.ds-row{border-top:1px solid var(--appliance-rule,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.1))}.ds-row span{color:var(--appliance-fg-dim,oklch(44% 0.008 70))}

components.name: Status Lamp
components.description: Signature: an 8px lamp lit only when live; steady running, pulsing in progress, red failed, unlit stopped.
components.html: RunningBuildingFailedStopped
components.css: .ds-lamps{display:flex;gap:20px}.ds-status{font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:var(--appliance-fg,oklch(19% 0.005 70))}.ds-lamp{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.18)}.ds-lamp-ok{background:var(--color-success,oklch(60% 0.14 148))}.ds-lamp-warn{background:var(--color-warning,oklch(79% 0.15 78))}.ds-lamp-err{background:var(--color-error,oklch(56% 0.2 27))}.ds-lamp-off{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--color-neutral-400,oklch(68.5% 0.008 74))}.ds-pulse{animation:ds-lamp-pulse 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) infinite}@keyframes ds-lamp-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-pulse{animation:none}}

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Flat rail on the canvas; ink washes for hover and active, uppercase only on group names.
components.html:
Infrastructure
ServersIntegrationsShared Variables
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;width:200px;padding:12px;background:var(--appliance-canvas,oklch(96.4% 0.004 80));border-right:1px solid var(--appliance-rule,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.1))}.ds-nav-group{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--appliance-fg-faint,oklch(52.5% 0.008 72));padding:8px 10px 4px}.ds-nav-item{display:block;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;color:var(--color-nav-text,oklch(44% 0.008 70));text-decoration:none}.ds-nav-item:hover{background:var(--appliance-hover,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.045))}.ds-nav-item.ds-active{background:var(--appliance-active,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.08));color:var(--color-nav-active,oklch(19% 0.005 70));font-weight:600}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--appliance-focus,oklch(57% 0.18 44));outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Sentence-case 12px headers, hairline rows, tabular figures, ink-wash hover.
components.css: .ds-table{font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;border-collapse:collapse;width:420px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;background:var(--appliance-surface,oklch(99.3% 0.002 85));color:var(--appliance-fg,oklch(19% 0.005 70))}.ds-table th{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;text-align:left;color:var(--appliance-fg-faint,oklch(52.5% 0.008 72));padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--appliance-rule,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.1))}.ds-table td{font-size:14px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--appliance-rule,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.1))}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--appliance-hover,oklch(19% 0.005 70 / 0.045))}.ds-mono{font-family:'Geist Mono',SFMono-Regular,Consolas,Menlo,monospace;font-size:13px}

narrative.overview:
Coolify as a Braun appliance (Dieter Rams): as little design as possible, every control obviously what it is. A warm light-grey body carries off-white working surfaces and charcoal type; dark mode is a graphite body, not black. Surfaces are flat colour, separated by hairline rules rather than nested boxes. The primary action is a charcoal key (an off-white key in dark mode). Colour appears only where it does a job: status lamps, focus, links, selection.

Density is upstream's: 14px UI text, 32px controls, compact rows. The skin changes how the screen looks, never what it does or says. It rejects the purple admin look of stacked card-in-well boxes and the near-black dev dashboard with one neon accent.
keyCharacteristics: Warm grey, never beige (chroma under 0.01 on every neutral, hue 70 to 85).
Charcoal primary key; orange is a signal, never a control fill.
One hairline surface per section; a section inside a section is a group on the same surface.
No gradients, glows, blur or soft shadows; overlays get a 1px hairline ring.
Status as indicator lamps: lit only when live.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange marks attention (focus, links, selection, caret) and never fills a control. Beta and "Try it" badges become a hairline outline in dim ink, not an orange chip.

rules.name: The Lit-Only-When-Live Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only as lamp states. Navigation chevrons, sidebar badges and the Coolify logo stay in ink (the logo is greyscale: `brightness(0.3)` light, `brightness(2.4)` dark).

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Buttons and table headers are sentence case (`text-transform: none` on `.button`). Uppercase tracking is reserved for the sidebar's navigation group names.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Anything that floats gets a 1px ring at Rule Strong, never a blur shadow. Buttons have no raised edge, lift or press translation.

dos: Do put every visual change in `resources/css/appliance.css`, using `html:root` / `html.dark` for tokens, `html:not(#icto-ui)` for components, and the `@layer utilities` block only to answer upstream `!important`.
Do re-point upstream tokens (`--color-coollabs*`, `--coollabs-*`, `--color-nav-*`, `--shadow-*`) rather than introducing parallel ones; use the `--appliance-*` semantic tokens in new rules.
Do give every overlay the hairline ring and every focusable element the 2px orange outline at 2px offset.
Do show status with the lamp, keeping colour for live states and leaving stopped resources unlit.
Do check both themes; dark is graphite (canvas oklch 21%), never black.
donts: Don't edit upstream Blade views or upstream CSS for a visual change when an override in appliance.css can do it.
Don't fill a control, badge or chip with orange; checked and selected states use the primary key.
Don't use gradients, glows, backdrop blur, soft or offset drop shadows, or hover lift on buttons.
Don't box a box: no well inside a well, no bordered row card inside a section body.
Don't reintroduce upstream purple (`#6b16ed`) or a brand-coloured logo.
